Name: Mitsui Looks
Author: zurakazura
Description:
让你的角色也能穿三井寿的衣服，SF模式：

[list=1]
[*]必须安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]才能使用
[*]FS模式该有的BUG都会有，比如做某些动作时裤子的贴图不匹配
[*]衣服的款式和配色主要参考漫画和动画
[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Make your character wear the clothes of Mitsui Hisashi in the game，FS mod：

[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] must be installed.
[*]FS mode will have all the bugs that are common to it, such as the mismatch of pants' textures when performing certain actions.
[*]The style and color scheme of the clothes are mainly based on the comic and animation.
[/list]
